verdict.rationale: Build and type-check scaling is a fair axis for a Rust web framework, but the evidence never addresses compile or check times in large codebases or monorepos. The benchmark repo reference (proa-gh-4) and the performance lints (proa-docs-13) concern runtime and rendering performance, not build-time scaling. Compile-time template validation is mentioned, but with no data on how it affects build times.
